home.intro: Goblins have burned the royal archive. Only the Great Registry survived — a magic book that answers questions asked in an ancient tongue: SQL. You can read it.

sqlErrors.noSuchTable: There is no table called "{table}". Check the name in the list of tables.
sqlErrors.noSuchColumn: There is no column called "{column}". Check its spelling and which table it belongs to.
sqlErrors.syntaxNear: The Registry did not understand the spell near "{token}".
sqlErrors.incomplete: The query ends too soon. Something is missing at the end (a condition, a column, a closing bracket…).
sqlErrors.ambiguousColumn: "{column}" exists in more than one table. Say which one, e.g. table.{column}.
sqlErrors.aggregateMisuse: {fn}() cannot be used here. To filter by an aggregate, use HAVING after GROUP BY.
sqlErrors.havingWithoutGroupBy: HAVING needs a GROUP BY before it.
sqlErrors.unique: That value already exists in {column}, and it must be unique.
sqlErrors.notNull: {column} cannot be empty: give it a value.
sqlErrors.check: One of the values breaks a rule of the table.
sqlErrors.foreignKey: This row points to something that does not exist in another table.
sqlErrors.valuesForTable: The table {table} has {columns} columns, but you gave {values} values.
sqlErrors.valuesForColumns: You gave {values} values for {columns} columns: the counts must match.
sqlErrors.functionArgs: {fn}() received the wrong number of arguments.
sqlErrors.subqueryColumns: The subquery returns {count} columns, but only one is expected here.
sqlErrors.rowValueMisused: A subquery used as a single value must return exactly one column.
sqlErrors.noTables: Say which table to read, with FROM.
sqlErrors.empty: The page is blank. Write a query before casting it.
sqlErrors.timeout: The query took more than {seconds} seconds and was stopped. Is there an endless loop?

tips.quoteText: If you meant the text {value}, write it in single quotes: '{value}'.
tips.closeQuote: A text is missing its closing single quote (').

mismatch.noResult: Your spell changed nothing visible: the task asks for a SELECT that shows rows.
mismatch.columnCount: Wrong number of columns. Expected: {expected} · yours: {actual}.
mismatch.columnNames: The columns are not the expected ones. Expected: {expected}.
mismatch.rowCount: Wrong number of rows. Expected: {expected} · yours: {actual}.
mismatch.rows: Same number of rows, but some are not the right ones (wrong: {unexpected}).
mismatch.order: The rows are right, but not in the requested order.
mismatch.hiddenData: It works with these records… but the Registry tested your spell on other pages and it failed. Don’t copy values from the results: let the query work them out.
mismatch.tableColumns: The columns of {table} have changed. Only change its data.
mismatch.tableRows: The table {table} is not as expected yet (rows missing: {missing} · rows that should not be there: {unexpected}).
